mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous three months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) over the previous two quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances following GDPC1 growth, or GDPC1 growth does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased wage pressures.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous three months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with increased consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous three months signals a contraction in economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with reduced corporate earnings.
